flavor: Thick, calcified roots weave through the floorboards like the ribs of a great beast, cradling a central slab of unpolished granite. A fine, rhythmic vibration hums through the soles of your boots, as if the stone itself were breathing.
name: The Ossuary of Roots
reason: The party must offer a piece of their history or a drop of blood to the stone to pass through the living gate.
